facts.fact: The Somali Media Association says Somalia still lacks an access-to-information law guaranteeing citizens and the press the right to obtain government information.

SOMA reports journalist Abukar Keynan of Risaala TV was beaten and held for an hour by government troops while covering a forced eviction, and another reporter was detained for hours in March 2025 while covering a protest.

SOM.note: No rural electricity access figure stated.
